note: AS-BUILT (implement ②, matches the intended design — the build followed the plan; one shared reassign(session,target) core now backs both R doors as FR4.4 required). Three deliberately separate surfaces over ONE binding — a session's tmux name. (1) /gogo:done becomes a pure in-chat ship (the board.py kanban + intent protocol retired; TestNoInteractiveBoardInSkills is the durable no-auto-board guard). (2) S opens modeSessions (board + drill): every live gogo-* session via the cached ListSessionMeta, rows from adoptRow; R re-assigns through the shared reassign core (refusals + derived action + rename via RenameSessionUnique), K closes via the killer seam; esc/q return to sessionsOrigin; forms route back through pickerOrigin. (3) /gogo:session-update (markdown skill) renames its own host session from inside — arg slug → conversation → ask, bindAction's cited rule, has-session collision suffix, exact =target, writes nothing. flow.mmd: the three doors onto the one name + every reader downstream. session-update.mmd: the drift case end to end. sequence.mmd: the panel's runtime. state.mmd: the cockpit mode machine with modeSessions. before/: the as-is baseline (board-launching done, card-only ops, the drift with no repair).
